stories.summary: Hamas has released four female Israeli soldiers under the multiphase Gaza ceasefire agreement. They are the second group of hostages freed since the deal took effect, raising hopes that the agreement could lead to a lasting end to the war.

links.excerpt: The hostages are the second set to be released since the multiphase agreement came into effect, raising hopes for a lasting end to the war.

stories.title: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
stories.summary: The world’s three largest container operators remain wary of returning to Red Sea routes despite a Houthi pledge to stop targeting ships. They cite instability in Gaza and broader regional tensions as reasons the danger may persist.

links.headline: Shippers Wary of Red Sea Routes Despite Houthi Pledge to End Targeting
links.excerpt: The world’s top three container operators said they fear instability in Gaza and broader regional tensions mean continued danger.
